title: Rate Committee Statement — Contract Rate on the AutoDraft Enrolment Day, Operating Lines of Credit
content:
On the day AutoDraft is enrolled on one of the Operating Lines of Credit, the contract rate is the Association Variable Base Rate in effect that day plus the product's spread, less the discounts.

## Statement

1. **Base rate.** The Association Variable Base Rate in effect on the enrolment day is the rate of the latest entry of the association's base-rate history dated on or before that day:

| Entry dated | Association Variable Base Rate (% a year) |
|---|---|
| Earliest entry, in effect for any day before 2025-10-30 | 7.750 |
| 2025-10-30 | 7.500 |
| 2025-12-11 | 7.250 |
| 2026-04-30 | 7.000 |
| 2026-07-30 | 6.750 |

2. **Discounts.** The discounts are the product's program discount, the product's AutoDraft discount, and the product's relationship discount when the member holds a Farm Real Estate loan in active status. They are added together and the total is capped at the product's discount cap.
3. **Rate.** The rate is the base rate plus the spread less the capped total, rounded to 3 decimal places and never set below the product's rate floor.

## Worked rates (hypothetical enrolment on 2026-08-10, base rate 6.750)

| Item | Revolving Operating Line, member holds an active Farm Real Estate loan | StartRight Operating Line, member holds an active Farm Real Estate loan |
|---|---|---|
| Base rate plus spread | 6.750 plus 0.30, that is 7.050 | 6.750 plus 0.65, that is 7.400 |
| Program discount | 0 | 1.000 |
| AutoDraft discount | 0.125 | 0.125 |
| Relationship discount | 0.15 | 0.10 |
| Discounts added together | 0.275 | 1.225 |
| Capped at the product's discount cap | 0.275 (cap 0.275) | 1.125 (cap 1.125) |
| Rate, rounded to 3 decimal places | 6.775 | 6.275 |
| Floor | 5.00 — not reached | 5.25 — not reached |

Without an active Farm Real Estate loan the Revolving Operating Line member's discounts total 0.125 and the rate is 6.925.

## Point of judgement

An enrolment dated 2026-07-29 takes the 7.000 base rate; one dated 2026-07-30 takes 6.750.
